notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.8.2 : Fancy Update (Part 3)
notes.notes:
[p](September 15th 2025)[/p][p][/p][p]I've heard you loud and clear. Everybody wants a better world map. The world is too blocky! I get it.[/p][p][/p][p]This will be the last "Fancy Update". The next update is the big one. Don't expect it for a couple of months but I will make sure the wait is worth it. But that's next update. Here is what I've been working on these past 2 months (Other than playing silksong).

The focus of this update was to make skills look and feel more unique from one another by adding sounds and animations. I also reworked breeding to be less of a chore.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]CHANGES[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Tulpa[/b] : Added 8 new evolutions. (Every tulpa evolves now).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tulpa[/b] : Most tulpas learn new and improved skills. (Cubble no longer learns a skill that regenerate mana, but no skill that uses mana)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tulpa[/b] : Bunibble's new evolution comes in 3 unique forms. (The forms are purely aesthetic)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tulpa[/b] : Bunibble was changed to come in 3 colors by default.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tulpa[/b] : Some descriptions in the bestiary were improved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle[/b] : Skills now have different sound effects and a few animations. (punching, throwing, dancing, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle[/b] : Status effects now have unique visual effects and sounds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle[/b] : Added the status effects "snare" and "shackle" which prevent the target from moving.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle[/b] : Added the status effect "Elemental shield" which will add temporary health of a certain element, regardless of the tulpa's actual element.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle[/b] : Slightly decreased stutter during battle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle[/b] : Added a summon/retrieve animation that also plays when you set your follower.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle[/b] : Added the "wake up" and "element chart" buttons from battle to the formation screen. (You can now give up before the battle even starts)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle[/b] : A tulpa's tooltip will now appear when you summon. (So you don't accidentally summon a tulpa with 1 HP)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Breeding[/b] : Eggs are now items and will hatch based on time, not battles fought.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Breeding[/b] : Added an animation when eggs hatch.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI[/b] : Added an inventory screen. (The only available items are eggs)[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI[/b] : Added a counter to keep track of elements unlocked in the element chart[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI[/b] : Added a counter to keep track of tulpas caught in the bestiary.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI[/b] : Added the last elemental background. (Light)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overworld[/b] : The exclamation mark above wild tulpas who spot you is made of cardboard and makes a sound.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overworld[/b] : Tulpas in later levels will now spawn as their evolved form, making later levels more difficult.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overworld[/b] : Wild tulpas are now guaranteed to spawn with skills that do damage and will priorities skills that don't cost mana to prevent battles where nothing happens.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overworld[/b] : Moved the dresser to the apartment to be easier to access. (It is no longer a reward for finding keys)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overworld[/b] : Moved the breeding CD to be easier to access.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Achievement[/b] : The achievement for hatching 100 eggs should trigger correctly now.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Achievement[/b] : Changed the achievement for "having a powerlevel of over 9000" to the trainer being level 100 instead.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lighting[/b] : Fixed a bug where the lighting would be wrongly affected by the room you are in during certain animations such as evolution.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.8.1.1 : Fancy Update (Quick Fix)
notes.notes: [p](July 21th 2025)[/p][p][/p][p]There were a few bugs that snuck in the last update. This quick fix addresses all the ones that were reported.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Balance : Tulpas in the reserve now get 25% of the experience even if they were not summoned.[/p][/*][*][p]Balance : Tulpas regenerate 2% of their max mana every turn.[/p][/*][*][p]Balance : Everytime you fail a catch, the catch chance increases by a small amount (Up to 33%).[/p][/*][*][p]UI : You can now check the tooltip of monsters in the formation screen.[/p][/*][*][p]World : Beds are now useable in the dream world and will simply wake you up.[/p][/*][*][p]World : CDs now give a popup telling you the name of the CD you just collected.[/p][/*][*][p]World : After some feedback, I removed the green light from the blue room (This sentence makes sense in context).[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed : Some skills were not checking the correct values when deciding if you could afford them. Sting in particular allowed you to kill yourself by using it.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed : Tooltips in the breeding menu would show all stats as 0 if the tulpa had the passive Hivemind.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed : The chef's uniform did not render and in some cases made you a floating head.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.8.1 : Fancy Update (Part 2)
notes.notes: [p](July 16th 2025)[/p][p][/p][p]This update focuses on adding passives and skills to all tulpas to differentiate them more from eachothers. There are still missing features I want to add such as placing mines and walls, but this is a big step forward. To compensate for the lack of new tulpas last update, I added 6 tulpas instead of the usual 3. I hope you enjoy this new version.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]ADDITIONS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Tulpa : Added 6 new evolutions.[/p][/*][*][p]Tulpa : Added 14 new passives.[/p][/*][*][p]Tulpa : Added a massive amount of new skills.[/p][/*][*][p]World : Added a ton of new NPCs to fight.[/p][/*][*][p]World : Added more objects and images to the world to make it feel less empty.[/p][/*][*][p]World : Added particle effects to certain zones for the atmosphere.[/p][/*][*][p]UI : Added 2 new elemental backgrounds.[/p][/*][*][p]UI : Added notifications when you unlock new clothes or new skills.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle : Added new status effects such as Frostbite, Mark, Snare and more.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]UI : Improved the evolution animation.[/p][/*][*][p]UI : Improved nearly every species' description.[/p][/*][*][p]UI : Made some tooltips more readable.[/p][/*][*][p]AI : Enemies will now use status effect skills and heals.[/p][/*][*][p]AI : Tulpas are guaranteed to spawn with at least 1 damaging skill equipped, including starters.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]World : Tulpas will no longer chase you once your trainer is a certain level above them.[/p][/*][*][p]World : Moved the breeding CD and dresser around to be less tedious to find for new players.[/p][/*][*][p]World : One of the secret worlds spawn lampicks instead of snoofs now.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle : Trainers can only put 3 tulpas on the field at the same time.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle : Movement and skills now uses different points that you get at the beginning of your turn allowing you to move, attack and then move again in some cases.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle : Using summon and retrieve no longer ends your turn (or use a skill point).[/p][/*][*][p]Battle : Rebalanced every tulpa's stats to be less homogenous.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle : Rebalanced some elements, notably Insect to be less boring and weak.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed : Crash that would happen if you hovered the mouse over portraits while summoning.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed : Bug where bosses would fail to spawn sometimes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed : Bug where holding the camera and entering the PC at the same time softlocked you.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed : Bug where trainers would be missing when you challenge them again but not give up when you kill their last tulpa, softlocking you in battle.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.8.0.1 : Fancy Update
notes.notes: [p](June 18th 2025)[/p][p][/p][h3][b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]UI : The game will now ask you before opening another window.[/p][/*][*][p]UI : Skills now have their range in their tooltips.[/p][/*][*][p]UI : Added the ability to rename your character.[/p][/*][*][p]Evolution : The evolution animation now loads faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Evolution : Slightly improved the evolution animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Evolution : Added a skip button to the evolution animation.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]World : Moved around the rewards for finding the blue keys.[/p][/*][*][p]Element : Toxic is now neutral against Insect.[/p][/*][*][p]Element : Toxic is now strong against psychic.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where touching enemies would fail to start a battle and you would become an immortal ghost (If this bug still happens, there is now a failsafe where using a door should fix it).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where bosses would sometimes not spawn.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where you would sometimes get stuck on chairs.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.8 : Fancy Update
notes.notes: [p](June 14th 2025)[/p][p][/p][h3][b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]UI : Added character customization.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]UI : Added a popup to see stat changes after an evolution.[/p][/*][*][p]UI : Re-added the feedback button that brings you to the steam forum.[/p][/*][*][p]UI : Added skill names to skill icons to differentiate them.[/p][/*][*][p]UI : Added some characters to text inputs so you can finally name your tulpa "xX_DeathAngel_Xx".[/p][/*][*][p]UI : Improved the look of the element chart.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overworld : Added several trainer battles.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Overworld : Defeating trainers unlock their clothes and stuff.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Overworld : Whether or not tulpas join in against you is now based on whether they are chasing you and if you are reachable instead of being distance-based.[/p][/*][*][p]Overworld : You are now considered "sneaking" while not moving and on controller your detection range is based on how fast you are moving.[/p][/*][*][p]UX : Clicking on a monster in the formation before battles selects it.[/p][/*][*][p]Sound : Added an evolution jingle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Animation : Gave everyone a cooler walk cycle.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Animation : Added scene transition animations to doors, waking up and battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Animation : Changed the death animation of trainers.[/p][/*][*][p]Animation : Added a falling-asleep/waking-up animation.[/p][/*][*][p]General : Changed some tulpa sizes and descriptions for consistency.[/p][/*][*][p]General : Improved venomiel's texture.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Battle : Reduced healing in general.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle : Capped recoil damage to how much health the target had left.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle : Dodge chance is now more consistent throughout the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle : Made catching low level tulpas easier.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle : Made Insect-type strong against Normal-type but weak against itself.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle : Damage and healing are now rounded down to 1 instead of 0.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle : Retrieving and then re-summoning tulpas no longer remove their status effects.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Battle : Fixed a bug where starting a battle without a tulpa but later summoning it from the reserve wouldn't award it experience.[/p][/*][*][p]UI : Made element unlocking more reliable.[/p][/*][*][p]Overworld : Fixed several edge cases based around entering battle immediately after entering a door or pausing right as you get attacked.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Overworld : Sometimes, switching clothes rapidly causes the wrong textures or models to load. This is purely visual and fixes itself when changing clothes again or closing and reopening the game.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]
